contact.evidence_quote: The 3rd National Roundtable Discussion on the Impact of Internationalization on Academic Rankings took place earlier this month at Krabi Tipa Resort, Krabi, Thailand. Participants included representatives of HEIs from all over Thailand, along with students, faculty and staff of PSU. The event was conducted by an invited expert on internationalization, the Vice President for International Relations and Corporate Communication at Mahidol University, Dr. Nopraenue Dhirathiti.
